editorial.blurb: A intimate gem where expert sushi craftsmanship meets warm hospitality, with signature touches like subtly sweet rice and inventive Korean-Japanese fusion that elevate every bite.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the bulgogi kimbop sushi and arrive with an appetite—portions are generous and the complimentary cinnamon tea and dried persimmon with walnuts provide a thoughtful finish; it's BYOB if you want to bring wine.
